title: pagerts
description: A TypeScript CLI that lists every link and resource a webpage references, as plain JSON.

content.heading: pagerts - Webpage resource extractor
content: pagerts fetches a URL (or reads a local HTML file) and prints every external resource it references - links, meta tags, scripts, styles - as JSON.

content.heading: From the README
content: PagerTS fetches web pages, parses their HTML, and reports each page's title, URL, and external resources - inspecting common resource-bearing tags, or scanning every element for selected link properties.
Requires Node.js 20 or later; installs globally with `npm install --global pagerts`.

content.heading: What you get
content: Output is a JSON array with one entry per input URL: a `title`, the `url`, and a `resources` array of `tag` / `key` / `value` / `link` objects.
A page that fails to load still gets an entry: `{"error": "Failed to load <url>: <reason>"}`.
Add `--no-json` for the same report as a human-readable log.

content.heading: Useful options
content: pagerts all <urls...> - scan every element instead of the default tags
pagerts --dry-run <urls...> - preview the effective settings without fetching
pagerts --tags a,img - restrict extraction to specific tags
pagerts -p data-href - add link properties to search
pagerts --timeout 5000 - abort fetches that take longer than 5s
